newsitem.title: USA: U.S. copper rod mill inventories up in March - ABMS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. copper rod mill inventories up in March - ABMS.

text.p: Total copper inventories at U.S. rod mills (including cathodes, scrap, rod and in-process material) rose by the end of March to 122,982,000 lbs from a February tally of 120,739,000 lbs, the American Bureau of Metal Statistics said.
Rod production rose to 354,881,000 lbs from 363,053,000 lbs in February. Receipts totaled 392,619,000 lbs in March up from February's total of 357,965,000 lbs.
Total shipments dropped to 378,798,000 lbs in March from a revised total of 380,248,000 lbs the previous month.
